description: Header file defining a fixed-capacity, variable-sized container 'static_vector' with internal storage, including implementation for trivial and non-trivial types, along with utility templates and storage classes.

classes.name: static_vector
classes.description: A fixed maximum size, dynamically resizable container with internal storage, similar to std::vector but with compile-time size limit.

methods.name: emplace_back
methods.description: Constructs and appends an element at the end of the vector.

methods.name: push_back
methods.description: Adds a copy or move of an element at the end.

methods.name: resize
methods.description: Resizes the vector, constructing or destroying elements as needed.

methods.name: assign
methods.description: Assigns new contents from count and value or iterator range.
